name: v_confirm_fixed100_mstca_v1
purpose: Pre-registered confirmation on source val of a post-hoc CV finding: training MSTCA for a fixed 100 epochs (V1) instead of inner-CE early stopping (V0) lowers false alarms without a material class-recall cost. The frozen T phase-1 verdict (TRADE_OFF, adopt T0) stays unchanged; only this protocol can change the training rule used by later experiments.

origin.hypothesis_source: Descriptive, non-registered CV analyses in section 3 of the T phase-1 doc (matched-FP class recall; FP versus epoch).
origin.val_exposure_disclosure: Source val is NOT pristine: S-ablation phase 2 already predicted val with S0-S3 best and last checkpoints (early-stopping training), and the S0 val observation last < best FP partly motivated the T group. No epoch-100 val prediction exists. Results must be reported as a confirmation on a previously used validation split, not as an untouched held-out test.

sections: environment incl. ATEN_CPU_CAPABILITY=default and golden policy

runs.per_run: One run per seed: fit = all source train windows minus the inner set (identical to S phase 2 / T phase 2 fit), 100 epochs, no early stopping. After each epoch: save checkpoint and state digest, compute inner class-balanced CE (inherited inner_ce), store inner logits. After epoch 100: replay V0 on the inner CE history, then predict all 34710 source val windows exactly once with the V0 checkpoint and once with the epoch-100 checkpoint (single pass if they coincide). No per-epoch val prediction; val never enters any selection.
runs.prediction_format: Store raw model logits as float32 [n, 2] together with original_cache_index and labels. Fault probability for all metrics = softmax over the float32 logits computed in float64, column 1 (identical to the S runner path model(x).double().softmax(1)).
runs.rerun_policy: Only after an infrastructure failure, identical configuration, failure logged.

arms.V0: T0 rule (inner-CE early stopping replay, inherited definition).
arms.V3_descriptive: Mean probability of the five V1 models on val; descriptive only, 5x MACs.

gates_in_run.reproduction: Seeds 42, 43, 44: (1) state digest of the V checkpoint at the S0 val best_epoch equals checkpoint_state_digests.best in artifacts/s_ablation_mstca_v1/val/S0_seed<s>_fold0/report.json; (2) the V0 replay selects that same epoch; (3) V0 val FP@R97 equals the S0 val best values 785 / 428 / 741. Any mismatch: STOP the sequence and report.

evaluation.uncertainty: Paired association_group cluster bootstrap on val, 2000 replicates, rng seed 20261106, one resample plan shared by all arms and seeds; t* recomputed per arm, seed and replicate.

criteria.C1_false_alarms: Geometric mean over seeds of FP@R97(V1)/FP@R97(V0) < 1.0, AND at least 4 of 5 per-seed ratios strictly < 1.0, AND bootstrap 95% upper bound of the geometric-mean ratio < 1.0.
criteria.C2_matched_fp_class_recall: Per seed, let k = FP@R97 of V0. Threshold V1 at t_m = the k-th largest V1 normal-window fault probability; alarm iff probability >= t_m (record the realised FP, which can exceed k only through ties). For every fault class, on fault windows outside late_hover_fault: seed mean of [recall(V1 at t_m) - recall(V0 at its t*)] >= -1.0 pp. Point estimates decide; a bootstrap CI is reported descriptively.
criteria.C3_r97_class_cap: At each arm's own t* (R97 operating point), for every fault class outside late_hover_fault, the seed-mean recall drop recall(V0) - recall(V1) <= 2.0 pp. Applies to all classes, GPS included (the CV concern).
criteria.C4_ap: Bootstrap 95% upper bound of the seed-mean delta AP (V1 - V0) >= 0.

evaluation.verdict: CONFIRMED_ADOPT_FIXED_100 if C1, C2, C3 and C4 all hold; otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED_KEEP_T0 with the list of failed criteria. Any undefined quantity needed by a criterion makes that criterion fail (inherited undefined_policy: no pseudocounts, redraws or dropped replicates).
secondary_descriptive: per-class recall at R97 for both arms, including late_hover_fault GPS/barometer
class-balanced CE and Brier from logits
across-seed SD of log FP@R97 per arm
V3 ensemble FP@R97 and its ratio to the geometric mean of V1
comparison with S phase-2 S0 best/last val FP for seeds 42-44
evaluation.consequence: If CONFIRMED: later experiments train MSTCA (and any compared architecture) for a fixed 100 epochs without early stopping, and S3 (MSTCA vs parameter-matched CNN) is re-examined under this rule in a separate protocol. If NOT_CONFIRMED: keep T0 and report the CV finding only as descriptive.

code_identities.new_scripts: scripts/research/train_v_confirm.py, scripts/research/evaluate_v_confirm.py, scripts/research/preflight_v_confirm.py, tests/test_v_confirm.py; written after this freeze; their normalized SHA256 sealed in a pre-run implementation manifest.

outputs: artifacts/v_confirm_fixed100_mstca_v1/val/seed<seed>/ (report.json, factory_receipt.json, checkpoints/epoch_<e>.pt, inner_logits.npz [100, n_inner, 2], val_logits_epoch_<e>.npz, selections.json) and artifacts/v_confirm_fixed100_mstca_v1/evaluation_val/. Fresh directories only.
preflight_gates: environment asserted (torch 2.5.1+cu124, numpy 2.1.3, CUDA, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, ATEN_CPU_CAPABILITY=default)
tests/test_mstca_ablation_factory.py, tests/test_s_ablation.py, tests/test_t_selection.py, tests/test_v_confirm.py: 0 failed, 0 skipped; 14 goldens unchanged
protocol lock; normalized code identities; nine data identities; T phase-1 evaluation SHA equals origin.t_phase1_evaluation_sha256
